newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 17.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Switzerland to slaughter 230,000 cattle to try and eliminate BSE "mad cow" disease, at an estimated cost of 1.3 billion French francs.
-- Michelin posts first-half profit increase up 50 percent from last year, due to restructuring, a rise in tyre prices and cost cutting. The company nevertheless lost its world-leader position.
-- Public works group Eiffage posts a 890 miilion francs loss for the first half.
-- Saint-Gobain to buy two U.S. glass firms, create a 2.23-billion-dollar-turnover unit.
-- Credit Agricole increases its stake to over five percent in Compagnie de Suez.
-- Car rental compagnies Hertz, Europcar and Citer fined for illegal use of labour in France.
-- Privatisation of GAN's subsidiary bank CIC more difficult than expected.
